mode.description:
Which packages to collect {@link TypeMeta} for. If mode is [CUSTOM](BaseCodeAnalyzer.CollectAppInfoMode#CUSTOM),
#pkgNames must also be provided.

rootPkgName.description:
The name of the {@link Pkg} to collect {@link TypeMeta} for when #mode is
[DEEP](BaseCodeAnalyzer.CollectAppInfoMode#DEEP). If not provided, the root package of
the application in which {@link BaseCodeAnalyzer#collectAppInfo} is running will be used.

pkgNames.description:
A list of {@link Pkg}s to collect {@link TypeMeta} for. This should only be provided
when #mode is [CUSTOM](BaseCodeAnalyzer.CollectAppInfoMode#CUSTOM).

resolvedVersionsMap.description:
Packages written to the {@link Pkg.Store} instead of read from {@link ArtifactHub}
will only have the `{major}.{minor}.{patch}` version, not the full {@link SemanticVersion}.

When [collectAppInfo](BaseCodeAnalyzer#collectAppInfo) is being run through a
[Release Management](Jarvis) pipeline, we'll have access to the full semantic
version for all packages written to the {@link Pkg.Store}. A map of {@link Pkg#name}
to their full semantic versions can be provided through this field to ensure that
the most accurate version for each package is collected.

title: Configurations for where to collect {@link TypeMeta} from in {@link BaseCodeAnalyzer#collectAppInfo}.
name: BaseCodeAnalyzer.CollectAppInfoSpec
